# Confirm the home shortcut chooses an actionable opportunity when statuses are mixed

## What & Why
When an already-applied opportunity sits alongside a saved or preparing opportunity, the home page should keep the shortcut focused on the actionable item instead of presenting the applied item as the next move.

## Done looks like
- A browser regression test creates applied and non-applied opportunities in the same queue.
- The home page names the actionable opportunity and shows exactly one Mark applied action for it.
- The behavior remains correct after reload.
